findings.description: Literal host Skill-load causality was unobservable and the prior read-only handshake did not cause an artifact.
findings.materiality: Promotion blocking until a real observable composition exists.
findings.required_evidence: Exact capability authorization, host-caused bounded mutation, artifact/browser/verifier digest chain, ordering and no conflicting producer.

findings.description: The pre-review packet mapped 33 catalog IDs to unrelated generic browser checks, allowing runtime requirements to false-pass without executing their stated behaviors.
findings.materiality: A false promotion decision was possible despite absent long-heading, performance, motion, validation and other required observations.
findings.required_evidence: One unique matching browser check per runtime-required catalog ID, catalog-specific runtime records, and rejection tests for aliasing or omission.
findings.source: Initial independent capability and frontend reviews

findings.description: The pre-review receipt asserted a write path that was absent from the raw host event, and its host_event_paths set was empty.
findings.materiality: The claimed producer-to-delta causal binding could not be independently reconstructed.
findings.required_evidence: Raw host events containing path and byte observations that exactly cover the independently observed changed-file set.

findings.description: The pre-review verifier was given precomputed observations and an expected PASS instead of a neutral evidence-reading surface.
findings.materiality: Its report was a schema echo rather than independent verification and could not contradict the builder.
findings.required_evidence: A read-only host adapter, neutral criteria, raw evidence reads or hashes, zero mutation, and criterion-level findings.

findings.description: At 200 percent-equivalent 195px CSS width, urgency, species and action values clipped and the navigation count wrapped incorrectly.
findings.materiality: Required reflow lost material patient information and interaction affordances.
findings.required_evidence: Finding-linked CSS repair plus a clean 195x844 Chromium capture with page scale factor 2 and full values.

findings.description: A retained idempotency key could be reused after the draft changed, while the fixture did not bind the key to a canonical payload.
findings.materiality: A changed intake could receive the earlier record, violating idempotency semantics.
findings.required_evidence: Client payload-bound key retention, server payload binding and 409 conflict behavior, plus browser receipts for same and changed drafts.

findings.description: URL filter initialization, refresh, history and invalid state lacked current runtime proof.
findings.materiality: State could diverge from navigable URL behavior.
findings.required_evidence: Real Chromium URL initialization, reload, pushState/popstate and invalid-state normalization.

findings.description: The request-number guard lacked an overlapping-response browser test.
findings.materiality: Older data could overwrite the current queue.
findings.required_evidence: Delayed request A, fast request B, B visible after A completes.

findings.description: Keyboard order, error focus, retry focus and visible focus lacked current runtime proof.
findings.materiality: Static semantics cannot establish operable keyboard behavior.
findings.required_evidence: Real focus traversal, Enter submission, error/retry focus and focus-style observations.

findings.description: Raw fetch failures could be exposed directly as user-visible product copy.
findings.materiality: Implementation details could leak and error messaging was not stable or actionable.
findings.required_evidence: Bounded user-facing copy and runtime error/recovery observations.
